name: Key Pair Matcher
description: Check whether a private key pairs with a public key or a certificate by comparing public key fingerprints.

reasons.matched: Paired (the private key and public key belong to the same key)
reasons.identical: Identical (both inputs are the same private key)
reasons.public_key_mismatch: Public key mismatch (same algorithm, different keys)
reasons.not_a_key_pair: Not a key pair (the two inputs use different algorithms)

examples.label: Compare two different RSA public keys
Compare an RSA and an EC public key

hints.compare: The comparison is based on the public key fingerprint, so a private key can also be checked against a certificate.

faq.q: Can I compare a certificate with a private key?
faq.a: Yes. The public key is taken from the certificate and compared with the fingerprint of the private key.

faq.q: Is a failed match an error?
faq.a: No. A mismatch is a normal result and the page still shows the full comparison details.
